biotools.summary: Translates between centrifuge RPM and relative centrifugal force using rotor geometry, reporting g-force or speed at rmin, ravg, and rmax. Convert mode handles rpm_to_rcf and rcf_to_rpm with rotor presets or manual radii in mm; transfer mode maps a source RPM on one rotor to an equivalent target RPM at matched rmax RCF; batch mode processes multiple spin steps from CSV or row arrays. A browser calculator and a Python library with command-line interface submit the same parameters to the Pepkio Tools API and return structured results with optional methods text and safety warnings.

credit.name: Pepkio
credit.note: Pepkio develops software tools and bioinformatics solutions for life science researchers, including laboratory calculators and analysis services.

function.note: Three modes (convert, transfer, batch) for RPM↔RCF conversion, rotor protocol transfer, and batch CSV processing.
